info.name: Sharing Vision Article API
info.description: API collection for managing articles in the Sharing Vision recruitment test. Includes creation, paginated listing, details lookup, updating, and deleting.

request.description: Creates a new article with field validations: Title (min 20), Content (min 200), Category (min 3), Status (must be publish, draft, or thrash).

query.description: Optional filter: publish, draft, or thrash

request.description: Lists articles in a paginated way based on :limit and :offset URL parameters. Can filter by status query parameter.
Retrieves the full details of a specific article by its ID.
Updates an existing article by ID. Supports PUT, PATCH, and POST methods. Fields are validated before applying updates.
Removes an article permanently from the database. Can also be called using POST /article/:id with ?action=delete.
